# ShieldingProps

`jaff.core.ShieldingProps`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Shielding of a photo rate, held as `Reaction.photo.shielding`.

## Constructor

`#!python ShieldingProps(type, props=None)`



## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `str` | Shielding model (e.g. `"leiden"`, `"db1996"`). |
| `props` | `dict[str, Any]` | Model-specific settings (e.g. `shielded_by`, `min_ncol`) as given by the user. |
| `tables` | `dict[str, Any]` | Data tables the model built for the generated code to interpolate over, keyed by file name (e.g. `shielding_<reaction>.hdf5`); written out by `write_shielding_tables`. |
